title: Cohen-Macaulay higher conormal and Kähler differential modules of squarefree monomial ideals
summary: Let $S=k[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ and let $I=I_Δ\subsetneq S$ be a nonzero squarefree monomial ideal. Motivated by the classical higher-order Kähler differential modules and by the theory of higher conormal modules, we study not only the higher conormal quotients $I/I^q$, but more generally the shifted quotients $I^r/I^q$, $1\le r<q$, in the same $I$-adic conormal filtration, together with their symbolic analogues $I^{(r)}/I^{(q)}$.
